reason: The orthorhombic cell, peak positions, and a likely Z = 4/Pnma average framework are well supported, but the submitted exact realization is not. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp is available, and the trajectory used a custom extracted-line intensity/cosine objective rather than a validated whole-profile refinement. That model still grossly underfits important observed intensities (for example, 25.416 degrees: 17.29 observed versus 0.72 calculated; 39.170 degrees: 14.02 versus 2.53), while materially different coordinate minima were found. The selected structure also retains the trajectory's acknowledged unusually sparse Y environment (only four Y-S contacts below 3.0 angstrom, with the next at 3.423 angstrom) and a broad Re-S range. Only the imposed all-4c Pnma model and one general-Y variant were meaningfully tested; lower-symmetry coordinate solutions and other scientifically plausible periodic realizations were not comprehensively instantiated and compared. Thus the data support the cell/Z and average framework more strongly than the submitted symmetry-constrained coordinates and ordering, so another solution attempt with proper whole-profile refinement and explicit alternatives is warranted.
